name: dbgauss-field-ramp-demo
description: Demonstration of a field ramp on the synthetic test model dbgauss whose fields were first reduced to 0/4/6 degrees (python -m codev_mcp.edit with a field_set): three steps raise fields 2 and 3 to 6/9, 8/12 and 10/14 degrees, each step optimizing from the previous step's candidate. Field 3 gets weight 2 while the fields grow and is restored to 1 in the last step. The lower bound of the S2 air space equals its starting value on purpose: CODE V accepts a start on a bound and moves the variable into the bounds. All values are demonstration values.
